scope: Post-review Expected Gradients explanation stability of six existing P1 V2 checkpoints
explained_selection: Fixed chronological linspace indices, including first and last test row; no target, error, prediction or attribution used in selection
background_source: Training X only, from the 2712 P1 V2 training windows
method: Expected Gradients finite-Monte-Carlo estimator, vectorized implementation numerically crosschecked against SHAP0.52.0 GradientExplainer
main_batch_policy: Prefer vectorized1024 if the frozen reference-pilot equivalence, finite input-gradient, input-independent batch and memory checks pass within1e-5 scaled attribution tolerance; otherwise256 if equivalent, otherwise stop.

pilot.selection: Same first4 fixed examples as the saved successful V2 reference pilot
pilot.purpose: Same-estimator computational equivalence and timing, not scientific model or explanation selection

execution.autograd_scope: Input gradients needed by Expected Gradients only; no optimizer, parameter update or retraining
execution.gradient_backend: Reuse the frozen, forward-validated V2 numerical adapter and saved-prediction1e-5 gates.
execution.common_random_numbers: Within an integration seed, keep background slot order, explained sample order and rseed identical across all models and loss arms
execution.per_job_sampling: Use the unchanged full128-by256 common path arrays. Vectorizing batches must not restart or reorder the random generator.
execution.library_variance_output: Reproduce the reference diagnostic var(samples)/sqrt(nsamples); it is not SE/CI or a new uncertainty estimator.
execution.model_checkpoint_policy: Only six newly trained own best_checkpoint.pt files, SHA256 verified, weights_only=True; no archived pickle or old pretrained load
execution.resume_policy: Only completed cells whose receipts and hashes match the same protocol, inputs, checkpoints, environment and code; never combine incompatible runs

attribution_contract.input_feature_order: Locked P1 V2 interleaved asset LogRet,Vol20 order
attribution_contract.output_order: Four NextRet outputs followed by four NextVol outputs, as dataset_metadata.json
attribution_contract.explained_function: Standardized model outputs; exact affine conversion of predictions, expectations and attributions to raw target units
attribution_contract.phi_raw: float64(phi_scaled) * float64(y_scale), with scale broadcast only on the output axis
attribution_contract.ensemble: For the same background, integration seed and test sample, average the three model phi tensors first; then compute absolute importance. Average expected values and predictions similarly. Do not average absolute seed importances to describe the ensemble.

importance.output_feature: mean(abs(phi), axes=(sample,lag)); preserves original thesis aggregation
importance.relative_feature_share: Normalize eight nonnegative feature importances within each output to sum to one; undefined if total is zero
importance.task_summary: First divide each output phi_raw by its training y_scale; average absolute importances over the four outputs within a task, then normalize eight feature scores

stability_factors.background: Compare four backgrounds pairwise holding model and integration seed fixed; include derived ensembles separately
stability_factors.model_seed: Compare the three fixed model seeds pairwise within each loss arm holding background and integration seed fixed
stability_factors.integration_MC: Compare the two integration seeds holding model and background fixed; include derived ensembles separately
stability_factors.loss_arm: Optional matched descriptive comparison only; never merge it into background or model-seed stability

stability_metrics.top_k_agreement: Jaccard of top-three sets; exact ties broken by locked feature order with tie count and continuous third-versus-fourth share gap reported
stability_metrics.share_distance: 0.5 * sum(abs(share_a-share_b)), total variation on eight feature shares
stability_metrics.magnitude_normalized_L1: sum(abs(importance_a-importance_b))/(sum(importance_a)+sum(importance_b)); undefined when the combined magnitude is zero
stability_metrics.pair_summary: Descriptive count, min, median, max; pairs share models/samples and are not independent replicates

diagnostics.additivity_residual: prediction_raw - expected_raw - sum(phi_raw over lag and feature)
diagnostics.normalize_residual: Divide raw residual by the corresponding training y_scale; retain raw and standardized diagnostics

interpretation_limits: The fixed 128-of-584 sample is not the original all584 SHAP analysis; conclusions are conditional on these explained windows and empirical training backgrounds.
Four backgrounds and two integration repeats are finite diagnostics; no universal stability or calibrated uncertainty claim.
Different backgrounds change the reference question; correlated features and off-manifold interpolations complicate causal interpretation.
Stable explanations do not establish predictive superiority, causality, positive/negative transfer or the correctness of feature timing.
P1 historical first availability and vintage clocks remain unverified.
No test/SHAP-based feature, seed, architecture, loss-weight or checkpoint selection.
Existing full-period and subperiod test performance was known before this post-review explanation analysis.
Finite forward checks support a numerically compatible differentiable adapter on the tested inputs. They do not prove global function equality or bit-exact derivatives of fused CUDA kernels.

The main computation is a separately implemented vectorized Expected Gradients estimator crosschecked against the pinned SHAP library on the fixed pilot; it is not claimed to be a direct GradientExplainer library call for all128 samples.
prohibited_actions: New model training or optimizer updates

gradient_adapter.method: Temporary encoder FFN GELU(tanh) under unfused MHA / SDPA MATH, preserving explicit head GELU and all state tensors
gradient_adapter.reason: Gradient-enabled original GELU(none) path differs numerically from the CUDA fused inference GELU epilogue used for the saved predictions.
gradient_adapter.additional_check: All six fixed models at the actual main prediction batch shape N128 must pass the same predeclared saved-prediction agreement gate.
gradient_adapter.limits: Finite forward checks support a numerically compatible differentiable adapter on the tested inputs. They do not prove global function equality or bit-exact derivatives of fused CUDA kernels.

estimator_engine.reference: Unchanged SHAP0.52.0 GradientExplainer V2 pilot, model mse_seed123/background reference/MC1/first4 fixed explained samples
estimator_engine.draws: Exactly the same MT19937 choice-then-uniform background slots and interpolation alphas, shared across all outputs/models
estimator_engine.interpolation: Compute alpha32=cast(alpha64) and beta32=cast(1-alpha64) separately, then alpha32*X32+beta32*background32; preserve original float32 operation order
estimator_engine.delta: Original float32 X32-background32 promoted to float64 before multiplication with the gradients
estimator_engine.input_gradients: One forward per interpolation batch, then eight input vector-Jacobian products of summed same-output predictions; valid because all model operations are independent across batch rows
estimator_engine.contributions: Mean over the same256 samples of float64(gradient32)*float64(delta32)
estimator_engine.variance_diagnostic: Population variance of sampled contributions divided by sqrt256, matching the reference implementation diagnostic only
estimator_engine.scope: Implementation optimization only; no importance-based model, sample or feature selection
